# Vendor libraries (local files so index.html works offline via file://)
| File | Library | Needed for |
|---|---|---|
| xlsx.full.min.js | SheetJS (https://cdn.sheetjs.com/) | Excel import only |

Barcodes and QR codes need **no vendor files**: they are generated by the built-in `js/barcode/LinearEncoder.js` (Code 128, Code 39, EAN-13, EAN-8, ITF-14) and `js/barcode/QrEncoder.js` (QR, levels L/M/Q/H).
